name: Sudeshna Mukherjee

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sudeshna Mukherjee writes poetry attentive to human behaviour, social inequalities and the natural world. Her books include Meanderings of the Mind: A Collection of Poemotions, published by Partridge in 2015, and Mélange. Her poems have also appeared in Yugen Quest Review.

“LIFE AT THE TRAFFIC SIGNAL”, her contribution to Kabita Live, follows a girl selling flowers while other children go to school. The traffic light’s recurring cycle becomes a measure of work, waiting and lost opportunity. As the girl grows into motherhood, the poem shows how deprivation can pass from one generation to the next.
